name: M A N I X
author: Manix648
description: Release from the hold early at 44.7% to avoid touching the ship portal and stay as the mini wave. Hold to the ceiling at 45% shortly before the ball portal and then drop down to the middle of the screen, spam between the platforms and then fall to the floor between the spikes and cube portal at 48% and stay there. Hold to the ceiling from 54%-58% to avoid invisible hitboxes on the floor. Time a quick click and then hold to the ceiling at 71.5% to go above the spikes on the floor whilst not dying to the invisible blocks. Go under the ball portal at 73% and then move back to the ceiling until 75% where you can fall to the floor between the spikes and slope shortly before your icon reaches the blue orb. Hold to the ceiling from 82%-86% to avoid obstacles on the floor. Free to the end from there.
